# Game support

<!-- Generated by `engine games support --markdown` (tools/game_support.ps1) from the engine's code and docs/games/support-notes.json. Do not edit this file: change the notes or the code and run the tool. -->

Last updated: 2026-10-12. How far JoyPro supports each game: 57 titles, 36 of them handled by JoyPro (every version separately), 21 only researched and documented. The marks come from the code (what each game integration implements); verification results, footnotes and the facts per title come from the hand-kept [support-notes.json](support-notes.json). In the app: Start page, `Supported games` next to `Your games`.

## Legend

- ✓ supported; ◐ partial or experimental (see the numbered note); ✗ not supported; — not applicable (the game has no such thing, or JoyPro does not handle the title).
- Support level: **native** = JoyPro reads and writes the game's own bind files for your real devices; **virtual vJoy** = the game reads too few joysticks, JoyPro feeds it one virtual joystick (vJoy, devices hidden with HidHide); **virtual Xbox pad** = the game reads no joystick, JoyPro feeds it a virtual Xbox 360 pad (ViGEmBus); **documented only** = researched, see the linked page, JoyPro has no integration.
- Numbers: Setup wizard / Auto Assign = rows in JoyPro's function table of the game; Cockpits = cockpits of the game's aircraft in the cockpit database; In-game test = passed / total steps of the best run.
- In-game test: ✓ a green in-game end-to-end run (JoyPro's test kit drives the real game); ◐ a run in game that was not fully green or covered only the menus; ✗ checked against installed game files only, or implemented blind from public files (the details say which).
- Every export backs up the files first, refuses to write while the game runs and writes only cataloged actions; see [README.md](README.md) and [../export.md](../export.md).
- Anti-cheat: JoyPro reads no game memory and injects nothing; it writes config files (or registry values) while the game is closed. vJoy, ViGEmBus and HidHide are signed drivers that anti-cheat normally accepts, but a game may refuse virtual devices.
- **Import**: reads the binds made in the game into a profile.
- **Export**: writes binds into the game's files (modes clean, add, merge, merge-overwrite).
- **Keyboard**: keyboard binds on request (--include-keyboard).
- **Modifiers**: binds with modifier buttons.
- **List refresh**: builds the command list on the user's PC from the installed game (refresh-db).
- **Watcher**: config watcher: engine sync status / diff / apply.
- **Axis tuning**: curves and dead zones written in the game's own response model.
- **Game settings**: game-wide control settings (engine ffb set --device *).
- **In-game FFB**: the game's own force feedback settings (DCS FF Tune, IL-2 feedback power ...).
- **Telemetry FFB**: JoyPro's force feedback from the game's telemetry (JoyPro.Ffb).
- **Telemetry recording**: records every session's telemetry, Tacview ACMI and CSV export (engine telemetry, docs/telemetry-recording.md).
- **vJoy mode**: virtual joystick (engine vjoy mode <game> virtual).
- **Xbox pad**: virtual Xbox 360 pad (engine vjoy mode <game> xbox).
- **Virtual functions**: engine vjoy functions for the game.
- **Setup wizard / Auto Assign**: JoyPro's function table for the game (DB\Functions\<game>.tsv), used by Auto Assign and the setup wizard.
- **Cockpits**: cockpits of the game's aircraft in JoyPro's cockpit database (DB\Cockpits).
- **Cheat sheet**: layout pictures / cheat sheets per game and aircraft (engine layout render).
- **In-game test**: JoyPro's in-game end-to-end test: result of the best run.

### Notes on the matrix

1. MSFS: modifier buttons of the same device only.
2. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): incomplete: the run reached Controls of the test aircraft, but the rebind of a button was not captured (the kit needs two clicks, fixed since); later runs did not reach the main menu on the portrait display.
3. Every game can be switched to the virtual Xbox pad, but JoyPro knows no pad layout of this game: it puts your inputs on free pad controls and you bind those in the game (rarely needed for a game that reads joysticks).
4. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): not run yet: X-Plane 12 was never started on this PC; its first start flies the tutorial and writes no joystick preferences before a quit.
5. X-Plane 12: only the per-device switch "control-loaded axes" for force feedback sticks; the sim has no stick force feedback effects of its own (plugins only).
6. FSX and Prepar3D: Ctrl/Shift/Alt on keys; no modifier on joystick binds.
7. Recommended once supported: one vJoy device, binds made in the game.
8. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): a bind made in Options > Controls is offered 3-4 s after DCS closed; Ignore, Take over, the offer at the next start, no dialog without a change and the tray notification with Review checked in the game (38/39).
9. DCS keeps its force feedback settings per device and aircraft (FF Tune), see In-game FFB; there are no game-wide control settings to manage.
10. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): a bind made in Key mapping is offered after IL-2 closed; Ignore, Take over and no dialog without a change checked in the game (27/29; the misses were OCR of the dialog title).
11. The game's telemetry has no world position: recorded and exported as CSV, no Tacview (ACMI) track.
12. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): not possible yet: the first start shows the user agreement (never accepted by a test), and without a saved key mapping there is no general.actions to export to.
13. IL-2 1946: one keyboard modifier on a key; joystick binds take no modifier.
14. IL-2 1946: 29 of 33 steps in game (seat hat, engine 4 throttle); fixed since, one green run pending.
15. Falcon BMS: the key file stays the one BMS manages.
16. Falcon BMS: only the one DX shift layer; no modifiers on axes.
17. Falcon BMS: 20 of 21 steps; entering an active cockpit failed (an earlier settings run: 20/26, trim calibration).
18. BYOJoystick: one modifier per bind (a joystick button for joystick binds, a key for keyboard binds).
19. VTOL VR (BYOJoystick): the list is built only when the BYOJoystick mod is installed.
20. BYOJoystick: one dead zone value per bind (take-over threshold, or a cut for slew and tilt); no curves.
21. VTOL VR native: invert and axis range only, no curve or dead zone.
22. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): simulated (stand-in process, the registry maps rewritten as the game stores them): 45/45. The in-game run waited for Steam's launch option question (answered by the kit since).
23. Nuclear Option: the game's calibration dead zone is not written.
24. Tiny Combat Arena: Controls.cfg (curves) is not written.
25. Live watcher test 2026-10-17 (`tools\e2e\games\Watchdog.ps1`): simulated (stand-in process, the ini rewritten in the game's format): 45/45. The in-game run stopped at a season-end screen with in-game cash, which the test does not dismiss.
26. G-Rebels: invert only.
27. X4: Shift/Ctrl on keyboard binds; joystick binds take no modifier.
28. X4: only the game-wide dead zone and inverts (Game settings), nothing per bind.
29. Recommended once supported: the virtual Xbox pad.
30. A native candidate; vJoy would help against index shifts.
31. Recommended: the Xbox pad or the Inputbinder mod.
32. Recommended once supported: one vJoy device.
33. Arma Reforger: multiplier and invert only; no dead zone or curve (the format is unknown).
34. Arma Reforger: vJoy did not appear in the game in four starts; suggested only for more than four devices.
35. Arma Reforger: the settings menus were explored in game; no scored run, the export is not yet checked in game.
36. ACE COMBAT 7: invert only (`:R`).
37. ACE COMBAT 8: only the pad keys set in the game are read (it stores no joystick binds).
38. ACE COMBAT 8: JoyPro writes nothing (checksummed settings, Easy Anti-Cheat); your binds reach the game through the virtual Xbox pad.
39. ACE COMBAT 8: nothing is written.
40. ACE COMBAT 8: nothing is written, so there is nothing to watch.
41. Virtual pad games: invert happens on the pad axis in JoyPro's forwarder.
42. Try the virtual Xbox pad of ACE COMBAT 8.
43. Recommended: the virtual Xbox pad.
44. Project Wingman: export and import seen in game; one full run of the test is pending (19/25 and 17/24 so far).
45. Hell Let Loose: Vietnam reads no joystick: JoyPro reads and writes its keyboard keys; the pad layout is the game's.
46. Battlefield: keyboard keys only until the live survey confirms the game's joystick numbering.
47. Battlefield: invert only (swapped halves).
48. Recommended: one vJoy device, binds made in the game.

## Details per title

Bind file and command list: where JoyPro reads and writes on your PC and what it builds the game's command list from (list size measured on the development PC, see [README.md](README.md#command-lists-on-a-fresh-install)). Device limits: what the game reads of your devices; the input limits with their confidence (verified = from the game's files or JoyPro's own code, documented = the game's docs, reported = players) warn in the virtual joystick planner ([../virtual-joystick.md](../virtual-joystick.md)).

## Keeping this page true

- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/game_support.ps1` writes this page; `-CheckOnly` fails when it is out of date (the engine smoke test runs it).
- `engine games support` prints the same facts as JSON (`--markdown`, `--html` for the page; `--notes <file>` reads other notes than the ones built into engine.exe).
- The check also fails when a registered game has no entry in the notes, a note names an unknown game or cell, or a note claims more than the code (notes may only turn ✓ into ◐, ✗ or —, each with a reason).
- After an in-game test run: update `test` of the game in the notes (level, result, date), then run the tool.
